description: This script manages the setup and maintenance of a nightly development environment for PyTorch, including virtual environment creation, package installation, and repository updates.

classes.name: Formatter
classes.description: Custom logging formatter that redacts sensitive info and formats log messages.

classes.name: Venv
classes.description: Class managing Python virtual environments, including creation, package installation, and environment activation.

methods.name: logging_manager
methods.description: Context manager setting up logging with file and console handlers.

methods.name: check_branch
methods.description: Checks if a Git branch can be safely checked out.

methods.name: install_packages
methods.description: Installs specified packages into the virtual environment.

methods.name: _ensure_commit
methods.description: Ensures a specific Git commit exists locally, fetching if necessary.

methods.name: _nightly_version
methods.description: Retrieves the nightly version hash from a PyTorch installation.

methods.name: checkout_nightly_version
methods.description: Checks out the latest nightly version of PyTorch, optionally creating a branch.

methods.name: pull_nightly_version
methods.description: Merges the latest nightly version into the current branch.

methods.name: _get_listing_linux
methods.description: Lists shared object files on Linux.

methods.name: _get_listing_macos
methods.description: Lists shared object and dylib files on macOS.

methods.name: _get_listing_windows
methods.description: Lists DLL and PYD files on Windows.

methods.name: _glob_pyis
methods.description: Finds all .pyi files recursively in a directory.

methods.name: _find_missing_pyi
methods.description: Finds missing .pyi stub files in target directory compared to source.

methods.name: _get_listing
methods.description: Gets platform-specific file listing including missing .pyi files.

methods.name: _remove_existing
methods.description: Removes a file or directory if it exists.

methods.name: _move_single
methods.description: Moves or copies a file/directory from source to target with verbose output.

methods.name: _copy_files
methods.description: Copies a list of files from source to target.

methods.name: _link_files
methods.description: Creates hard links for a list of files from source to target.

methods.name: move_nightly_files
methods.description: Moves PyTorch files from temporary install location to repository.

methods.name: write_pth
methods.description: Writes a .pth file in site-packages pointing to the repo root.

methods.name: parse_dependencies
methods.description: Parses package dependencies from a wheel’s METADATA.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs the full setup: creates venv, installs torch wheel, dependencies, and checks out or pulls nightly.

methods.name: make_parser
methods.description: Creates argument parser for the script.

methods.name: parse_arguments
methods.description: Parses command line arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point orchestrating the setup process based on CLI args.
